profile.headline: Software Engineer at Red Lens Games
profile.summary: Graduated from the University of Kansas in May 2020 with bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering. Currently working as a software engineer at Red Lens Games.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
●	Create large scale automated UI testing framework
●	Write Python to implement automated writing and executing of UI tests
●	Implement features and fix bugs for Garmin chart plotters using C
●	Work with image comparison algorithms to implement UI test validation

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
●	Assist in development of real-time raytracing simulation of communication networks
●	Develop CUDA C++ for simulation of raytracing
●	Write C++ for visualization of simulation using OpenGL

positions.title: Network Architect
positions.description:
●	Create and update documentation centered around whole network overhaul
●	Write C# and Python for automatic generation of network documentation
●	Management of Aruba and Cisco switching/routing configuration

company.name: University of Kansas - School of Engineering

educations.degreeName: Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering (B.S.CoE)

honors.title: 1st Place HackKU 2020
honors.description:
1st Place in the financial tech. track for development of Mooxter.
Mooxter is a peer-to-peer payment transfer system built on the XPR API, Xpring made by Ripple. This system was build on a Kubernetes network and allowed for payment transfers in many everyday applications, such as Discord, Slack, or Twitter. 
http://Mooxter.com
honors.issuer: Issued by University of Kansas · Feb 2020

honors.title: HKN Undergraduate Achievement Award
honors.description:
Award for being one of the top 3 students in sophomore level classes.
Awarded for EECS 221 Electromagnetics I
honors.issuer: Issued by HKN KU Chapter · Feb 2019

organizations.name: Tau Beta Pi
organizations.description: Member of the KU chapter of Tau Beta Pi engineering honor society
